nina_sales: Need a hosted API key for a 5-day POC with VestaHealth. Requirements: embeddings + chat only, IP allowlist, rotate keys every 24h, and no dashboard access. Can we give them a self-serve rotate link?
eli: Yes. We can create a scoped template and either: (A) provide a one-time provisioning URL that mints a 24h token, or (B) hand them a client credential bound to CIDRs that can mint new 24h tokens (self-service rotate). Which do they prefer?
nina_sales: They want self-serve rotation from their infra. Org ID: VH-908. CIDRs: 44.55.0.0/16. KMS wrapped.
ciso_liz: Confirm audit retention 90d and immediate revocation API with proof. Also ensure tokens include provisioning metadata.
eli: Confirmed: KMS-backed, metadata fields provisioned_by/sales_deal/poc_id, revocation via DELETE /v1/poc-keys/:id (service account), revocation events exported to S3. I'll create template tpl-vh-03 and a client credential scoped + CIDR-bound.
ops-bot: create-template tpl-vh-03 {"scopes":["embeddings","chat"],"allowed_cidrs":["44.55.0.0/16"],"no_console":true} -> success (tpl-vh-03)
ops-bot: client-cred created cred-vh-556, expires: 2026-03-28T12:00:00Z, mint-endpoint: https://api.redwood.com/v1/poc-keys/mint (rate limit 10/day)
nina_sales: Perfect. Please set 24h TTL by default and share the client credential to my secure channel. I'll send runbook: claim -> rotate daily -> offboard revoke + logs export.
eli: Done. Adding sales-poc-provisioner to metadata and enabling SIEM s3 export.
nina_sales: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
